 ORDER

This is first application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 135/2020, dated 22.10.2020, registered at Police Station-Chhoti Gwaltoli,
District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420 & 406 of IPC.
2. As per prosecution story, it is alleged that the complainant paid Rs.61 lakhs to the applicant for supply of 520 tons sugar @ of Rs.18.5 per kg but the applicant could not deliver the sugar.
3. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
The applicant is now ready to deposit the 50% of the total amount of Rs.61 lakhs in two installments.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.

The applicant is in custody since 08.04.2023 and final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time,
hence counsel prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text:
4. Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application by submitting that the there are eight criminal cases registered against the applicant of same nature,
hence, no case is made out for grant of bail.
5.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation and custody period of the applicant, it will be appropriate to enlarge the applicant on bail on a condition that he will deposit 50% of the amount misappropriated by him which comes to Rs.30,50,000/- before the trial Court in two installments and thereafter, the trial Court shall disburse the same to the complainant after obtaining appropriate undertaking in this regard.
6.
Consequently, without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that subject to fulfilling the aforesaid condition applicant-Sharan be released on bail subject to deposit 50% amount i.e. Rs.30,50,000/- in two installments by the applicant or any other person on his behalf.

The first installment shall be deposited before releasing on bail of the applicant and second installment shall be deposited within a period of two months from the date of releasing on bail of the applicant and also on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties (out of which one local surety) each in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five thousand only) to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.

Learned counsel for the applicant has also submitted that in the cause title in the application, the name of the father of the applicant has been mentioned as Umashankar Salgere More instead of Umakant Salgere More, hence, request for correction in the name of father of the applicant in the cause title.
Prayer is allowed.
The father's name of the applicant be read as "Umakant Salgere More" instead of "Umashankar Salgere More" in the application.
Certified copy as per rules.
